MongoDB is rapidly expanding its Strategic Account Marketing efforts to drive significant business growth with our highest-value Global accounts. We are seeking an innovative and collaborative Sr Marketing Manager to execute key programs in India for select strategic accounts, coordinating across Global account plans with peers in EMEA and AMER 

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for developing and executing 1:1 and 1:few Strategic Account Marketing plans to accelerate growth in our most important accounts that have a large developer and technical team presence in India. You will be a highly strategic, results-driven professional with a passion for marketing and a direct impact on our developer mindshare, upmarket initiatives, and revenue goals.

This position will report to the Head of India Marketing, although will work very closely with with EMEA and AMER Strategic Account Marketing leaders, and the larger APJ marketing team.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategic marketing programs for select Global accounts with developer arms in India. Work closely with account teams to uncover account-specific challenges, understand decision-making processes, and identify key personas, to drive the creation and execution of tailored marketing strategies and messaging that address the unique needs and interests of each account, unlock senior leadership and buying team engagement, and lead to growth opportunities. You’ll work closely with the strategic account marketing leads, developer advocacy teams, sales teams and customers to ensure delivery of a holistic DevRel Marketing program within each account.
  • Bring the marketing expertise: Act as a strategic marketing consultant to sales teams and clients, recommending tailored programs and tactics that align with both sales objectives and client needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work closely with cross-functional teams  like field marketing, partner marketing, customer marketing, demand generation and developer advocacy teams to ensure delivery of a holistic marketing strategy within each account that incorporates cross functional programs into 1:1 Strategic Account Marketing plans. 
  • GTM alignment: Work closely with the sales team to align marketing efforts with sales goals, provide sales enablement resources, ensure smooth handoff of qualified leads,  and communicate and educate the sales team regarding new and planned marketing activities including global, regional, and account specific programs.
  • Measure impact & optimize: Track performance metrics and ROI, ensuring processes are in place to evaluate the effectiveness of your programs,  and apply insights to refine and optimize ABM campaigns for maximum impact.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • Educational and Professional Background:
    • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
    • 7+ years of account marketing, field marketing, industry marketing or sales experience in the Tech area.
    • Experience working with large and complex Global enterprise accounts across multiple verticals including:  FSI, Manufacturing, Automotive Retail, and others, with a proven success record in planning and executing effective marketing programs
  • Skills and Expertise:
    • Experience with strategic 1:1 or 1:few account-based marketing, leveraging multi-channel tactics across digital and F2F.
    • Experience working with cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), ISV, AI, and other tech partners.
    • Incredible written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting to sales and marketing leadership, as well as customers. 
    • Impeccable event and project management skills, ensuring seamless planning, coordination, and delivery of initiatives with an ability to problem-solve quickly.
    • Results-oriented and analytically skilled, capable of interpreting data, making informed data-driven decisions, and reporting insights to the business.
    • AI-savvy with strong desire to understand and learn how AI tools and processes can be used in daily work. 
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Experience working cross-functionally with enterprise or corporate sales, customer success teams, and account development teams, obsessing over addressable market and specific account goals.
    • Capable of establishing credibility with sales partners to effectively convey marketing value propositions and key messages.
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Salesforce, and marketing technology tools like 6sense, Eloqua, Pathfactory, Sigma, Tableau.
  • Attributes and Work Style:
    • Must be a highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial professional who can excel in an autonomous work environment and proactively drive initiatives.
    • Ability to leverage data to inform decisions and strategic plans.
    • Bring a strategic and creative mindset to the team, collaborating effectively to generate new ideas.
    • Growth mindset and results-oriented
    • Team ethos is made up of good humor, a positive can-do attitude, yet high standards and focused on impact.
    • Time management, prioritization, and organizational skills are key.
  • Additional Requirements:
    • Proven experience working with Global teams and key APAC markets, including India, Vietnam, Thailand, and China.
    • Travel as required.

Success Measures:

The Strategic Accounts Marketing Programs Manager will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

  • In 3 months you’ll have fostered a relationship with your Sales Account teams (ex: sales, solution architects, field partner leads, customer success) to understand their account priorities, begin planning marketing programs, and ramp on current account status and MongoDB product knowledge. 
  • In 6 months you’ll have a clear understanding of your key objectives, have executed marketing activities with pipeline influence, and have started to become a trusted partner to your account stakeholders. 
  • In 12 months you’ll have cemented yourself as a key account partner, be fully ramped and actioning against all account objectives.

 

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

Headquarters: Denmark
 
URL: https://ixdf.org/about/careers

You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire. The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name the ten leading designers who should be teaching the world’s best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads at Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heights and make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

• 

Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers. This is the role described here.

• 

Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

• 

Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the world’s leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, our other Course Directors, and the Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

• 

Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

• 

You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look at where design and AI are heading, what designers need that nobody has taught well yet, and what we should retire because the field has already moved on.

• 

Find the people who should teach it. You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

• 

Decide what each expert should teach. The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

• 

You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

• 

Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

• 

Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

• 

Make an impact as you pressure-test the courses our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved. You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

• 

You're one of the people whose judgment the rest of the team leans on. You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll grow personally and professionally.

• 

Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

• 

Bring your subject matter expertise to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

About Us
HighRadius, a renowned provider of cloud-based Autonomous Software for the Office of
the CFO, has transformed critical financial processes for over 1000+ leading companies
worldwide.Trusted by prestigious organizations like 3M, Unilever, Anheuser-Busch InBev,
Sanofi, Kellogg Company, Danone, Hershey's, and many others, HighRadius optimizes
order-to-cash, treasury, and record-to-report processes, earning us back-to-back
recognition in Gartner's Magic Quadrant and a prestigious spot in Forbes Cloud 100 List for
three consecutive years.
With a remarkable valuation of $3.1B and an impressive annual recurring revenue
exceeding $100M, we experience a robust year-over-year growth of 24%. With a global
presence spanning 6+ locations, we're in the pre-IPO stage, poised for rapid growth. We
invite passionate and diverse individuals to join us on this exciting path to becoming a
publicly traded company and shape our promising future.
Job Summary
The Associate Project Manager (PM) is responsible for managing and delivering consulting
projects to Fortune 1000 Customers. He/ She will be owing client engagements and
executing these projects parallel till closure. The APM is also responsible for creating project
plans, executing those and delivering on time with high quality, value and with customer
delight. This is a highly visible and complex role since the candidate will be the point of
contact and work with executives and users across the entire organization working on
multiple accounts. The successful candidate must be extremely well organized, focusses on
details, process-oriented, quality- minded and has the ability to articulate in written/verbal
form. He/ she will not only use the existing methodologies/ templates for effective project
execution, but also have the opportunity to recommend process improvements.
Key Responsibilities
● Handle a portfolio of projects and clients in parallel from Fortune 1000 companies
and across geographies.
● Establish and maintain strong relationships with product delivery, the sales team,
client and account managers.
● Plan for a quarter ahead and develop an execution plan for projects and people in
the team.
● Monitor and Track Projects to ensure the Scope is delivered within Budget and
Schedule per plan. Also ensure the Value/ROI committed to the customer is
delivered.
● Align with the recommended Processes to ensure 100% Quality Delivery with quality
Documentation.
Skill & Experience Needed
● Bachelor or Master’s Degree (preferably from a top reputed university), with Project
Management certification.
● Overall 8-10 years of professional services experience
● Minimum 2-3 years of experience as Project manager or equivalent role
demonstrating management and leadership experience, preferably in a fast paced
consulting/professional services set-up.
● Experience in leading and mentoring people as part of the project life cycle.
● Hands on ERP Implementation experience
● Experience in Banking/Treasury domain is preferred
● Strong organizational skills and detail oriented.
● Strong Communication and presentation skills.
What You’ll Get
● Competitive salary.
● Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)
● Equal employment opportunities.
● Opportunity to build with a pre-IPO Global SaaS Centaur.
